newsitem.title: USA: AEP 1,300 MW Rockport, Ind. coal unit shut.
newsitem.headline: AEP 1,300 MW Rockport, Ind. coal unit shut.

text.p: American Electric Power Co Inc's 1,300 megawatt Rockport, Ind. coal fired unit was shut Wednesday after a vibration was discovered in a bearing in a high-pressure turbine shaft, a company spokesman said.
"Depending on the nature of the repairs, the unit should be back on line early next week," company spokesman Ken Drenten said Wednesday.
Rockport is about 35 miles east of Evansville, Indiana.
Drenten said he could not comment on whether AEP would have to purchase power on the spot market as a result of the loss of the unit.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
